data.title: AION Development System — Team Edition premiere

actions.description: COMDEX November 1981 scenario launch: Complex products. Whole teams. One development environment. Demonstrate task → branch → code discussion → conflict resolution → CP/M and AIONix builds → target testing → labelled release. Campaign budget is staged in team_development_program.json; the accepted budgets are now reconciled into the investment and ROI models through 1982.

Rapid adoption price $745.23, 50% below the frozen $1490.45 launch proxy, with original four-user entitlement, 20h onboarding and 12h first-year support preserved. Explicit below-cost exception, losses disclosed in pricing_results.json and team_development_program.json.
